action.rationale: Discriminator for every arm of the exhaustive match in task_router.rs; load-bearing for the whole facade.

format.rationale: Cross-cutting response-shape selector (json/markdown/full) read by format_facade_response and wants_full_format across many arms.

verbose.rationale: Drives the slim-vs-full payload shape on multiple surviving actions (board/profiles); spec names it shared.

include_card.rationale: Recommend/card top-level mbit_card toggle (#1201) — tuning/profile/card surface, defer to #1467.

execution_level.rationale: Declared side-effect level L0-L3 admission knob; execution-bottom, not in the public Task ledger surface.

dispatch_reason.rationale: Required-only-by-Dispatch native-first exception gate; Dispatch arm is removed in [1319-C2].

agent_id.rationale: Ledger identity of the requesting agent; threaded into TaskBriefParams and briefing.

domain.rationale: Area tag for plan/briefing context scoping; survives Dispatch removal.

path_prefix.rationale: Recall path-prefix filter for context recall; tuning-knob surface aligned with #1467.

top_k.rationale: Max context fragments to recall; tuning knob, defer to #1467.

doc_paths.rationale: Canonical docs prioritization; tuning/context surface, defer to #1467.

related_issues.rationale: Related issues for close_loop/build_references; advisory context surface.

spec_paths.rationale: Canonical spec docs prioritization; tuning/context surface, defer to #1467.

include_global.rationale: Briefing scope-expansion toggle; tuning knob, defer to #1467.

compact.rationale: Agent-facing tight packet toggle; tuning knob, defer to #1467.

agent.rationale: Agent backend id; maps to StaffStartFields.worker (the executor identity).

outcome.rationale: Terminal outcome (success/failure/partial/aborted) recorded by Complete; spec-named shared.

task_id.rationale: Optional task id recorded by Complete; survives as a complete/submit shared field.

task_type.rationale: Standard task type stamp (fix_request/plan_request); recorded by Complete, read by Briefing.

duration_ms.rationale: Execution duration recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared evidence.

skills_used.rationale: Skills actually used; recorded by Complete, distinct from dispatch prompt skills.

cost_tokens.rationale: Token cost recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared evidence.

cost_usd.rationale: USD cost recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared evidence.

quality_score.rationale: Quality score recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared evidence.

trajectory.rationale: Execution trajectory recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared evidence.

diff.rationale: Unified diff evidence recorded by Complete; spec-named shared.

subagents.rationale: Structured subagent eval records recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared.

eval_run_ids.rationale: #1066 eval-run projections recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared.

feedback_rules_applied.rationale: Prompt-quality rule ids recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared.

signatures.rationale: Vendor-keyed error signatures (#735); spec-named shared, used by surviving Complete/Adjudicate.

rulings.rationale: Leader adjudication rulings (#950); spec-named shared, recorded by Complete.

adjudication.rationale: Terminal adjudication block (#1035); spec-named shared, used by surviving Complete/Adjudicate.

evidence_refs.rationale: Verification evidence references recorded by Complete; spec-named shared.

tests_run.rationale: Verification commands recorded by Complete; spec-named shared.

diff_present.rationale: Diff-presence flag recorded by Complete; complete/submit shared.

scope.rationale: Target DB scope (global/project); used by surviving Complete/Adjudicate.

cwd.rationale: Working-directory execution knob; spec lists cwd as operator-only execution-bottom.

env_id.rationale: Execution-environment lease id (#894 S1); execution-bottom, Dispatch-only build of TachiDispatchParams.

unmanaged_cwd.rationale: Bare-cwd opt-in execution knob; Dispatch-only, operator-internal.

skills.rationale: Skill ids injected into the dispatch prompt; execution-bottom, Dispatch-only.

context_query.rationale: Extra recall query injected into the dispatch prompt; execution-bottom, Dispatch-only.

model.rationale: Model override for the spawned agent; spec lists model as operator-only execution-bottom.

timeout_secs.rationale: Execution/poll timeout knob consumed by dispatch + control loops; spec lists timeout_secs as operator-only.

permission_profile.rationale: Permission profile execution knob; spec lists permission_profile as operator-only.

allowed_tools.rationale: Tool allowlist execution knob; spec lists allowed_tools as operator-only.

completion_predicate.rationale: Machine-checkable completion gate (#878-A); spec lists completion_predicate as operator-only.

max_turns.rationale: Maximum conversation turns execution knob; spec lists max_turns as operator-only.

sandbox.rationale: Codex sandbox mode execution knob; spec lists sandbox as operator-only.

inject_tachi_mcp.rationale: Tachi MCP injection toggle; spec lists inject_tachi_mcp as operator-only.

inject_hub_mcps.rationale: Hub MCP injection toggle; spec lists inject_hub_mcps as operator-only.

command.rationale: Explicit command argv override; spec lists command as operator-only execution-bottom.

harness_transport.rationale: Harness transport override; spec lists harness_transport as operator-only.

harness_server_url.rationale: Harness server URL for attach transports; spec lists harness_server_url as operator-only.

project.rationale: Named project DB; duplicates StaffStartFields.project. Survives, but its canonical home is Staff.

project_explicit.rationale: #1041 B7 wire-explicitness signal for transport-injected project default; travels with project ownership into Staff.

profile.rationale: Dispatch profile id; duplicates StaffStartFields.profile (the executor profile).

credential_profiles.rationale: Credential profile ids materialized before spawn; spec lists credential_profiles as operator-only.

repo.rationale: owner/repo target for intake/refine; survives as a workflow-shared field.

number.rationale: Issue number target for intake/refine; survives as a workflow-shared field.

issue_ref.rationale: GitHub issue ref; duplicates StaffStartFields.issue_ref. Many arms read it, so its canonical home is Staff.

pr_ref.rationale: GitHub PR ref; duplicates StaffStartFields.pr_ref. Many arms read it, so its canonical home is Staff.

flow_id.rationale: Tachi flow id linking artifacts back to a flow; duplicates StaffStartFields.flow_id.

dispatch_id.rationale: Dispatch ledger linkage for lifecycle events; survives across status/cancel/wait/complete.

outcome_id.rationale: Direct outcome id for Adjudicate; survives as an adjudicate-shared field.

include_result.rationale: Status response shape toggle (#878-C); survives as a status-shared field.

risk.rationale: Risk override for recommendation/routing/intake automation plan; tuning/profile surface, defer to #1467.

tool_profile.rationale: Expected child-agent tool surface; execution-bottom, Dispatch-only build of TachiDispatchParams.

auto_capability_bundle.rationale: Capability-bundle injection toggle; execution-bottom, forwarded into TachiDispatchParams.

mcp_access.rationale: MCP/GitHub access contract for the spawned agent; spec lists mcp_access as operator-only.

allowed_mcp_servers.rationale: Hub MCP server ids the dispatch may inject; spec lists allowed_mcp_servers as operator-only.

state_filter.rationale: Board/proposals ledger row filter; survives on board surface.

limit.rationale: Maximum ledger/proposal rows to return; survives on board/recommend surfaces.

proposal_id.rationale: Route-policy proposal id; routing/profile/recommendation surface, defer to #1467.

review_status.rationale: Review status for route-policy proposal review; routing/profile surface, defer to #1467.

worktree.rationale: Local dispatched worktree path used by Merge and recorded by Complete; survives.

branch.rationale: Local worktree merge branch / claim branch hint; survives.

strategy.rationale: Local worktree merge strategy; survives on merge surface.

merge_policy.rationale: Passed through to tachi_gh lifecycle helpers, not read by any tachi_task arm; conservative keep.

allow_umbrella_close.rationale: Umbrella/no-close override for tachi_gh helpers, not read by any tachi_task arm; conservative keep.

delete_worktree.rationale: Remove-worktree-after-merge toggle; survives on merge surface.

confirm.rationale: Leader confirmation gate for merge/apply_proposals and dispatch issue-flow bypass; survives.

wiki_title.rationale: Wiki closure entry title; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_text.rationale: Wiki closure entry body; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_path.rationale: Wiki closure path; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_topic.rationale: Wiki closure topic label; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_summary.rationale: Wiki closure short summary; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_category.rationale: Wiki closure category; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_keywords.rationale: Wiki closure keywords/tags; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_entities.rationale: Wiki closure named entities; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_importance.rationale: Wiki closure importance; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_scope.rationale: Wiki closure scope; survives on close_loop surface.

wiki_domain.rationale: Wiki closure area/domain tag; survives on close_loop surface.

force.rationale: Bypass wiki noise filtering on close_loop; survives on close_loop surface.

inject_card.rationale: tachi#1202/#993 lane-card countermeasures overlay toggle forwarded only to TachiDispatchParams::inject_card; Dispatch-only.

agent_identity_id.rationale: Stable AgentIdentity id for WorkClaim lifecycle; survives across claim/release/heartbeat/handoff.

claim_role.rationale: Per-work claimant role; survives on claim surface.

claim_mode.rationale: WorkClaim mode (read_only/writable); survives on claim surface.

worktree_path.rationale: Canonical writable worktree path for WorkClaim; survives on claim surface.

claim_scope.rationale: Declared file scope for collision checks; survives on claim surface.

expected_head.rationale: Expected Git head for compare-and-swap; survives on claim surface.

lease_expires_at.rationale: Lease expiry timestamp for WorkClaim; survives across claim lifecycle.

transition_version.rationale: Required WorkClaim transition version for CAS; survives across claim lifecycle.

claim_id.rationale: WorkClaim id; survives across claim lifecycle.

release_reason.rationale: Explicit release reason; survives on release surface.
